description: A support landing section with a floating chat panel, quick-reply suggestions, and a launcher button.
overview: A support page with a floating chat panel holding a greeting, quick-reply suggestions, the conversation and a composer. Closing the panel shrinks it into a round launcher button that reopens it. The panel spans the bottom of the screen on mobile and docks to a corner on larger screens. Use it as the in-app help widget for a store, a SaaS product or a docs site.
usage: Edit the `answers` record: each key becomes a quick-reply button and its value is the canned answer, while any other question gets a fallback about connecting to a Specialist. The `ask` function fakes a reply after a delay, so replace it with your support bot or live-agent API. Change the greeting and the hero photo in the `image` constant.
notes: Focus returns to the launcher when the panel closes. The hero photo is an Unsplash placeholder.
